_comment: Regression baseline for the shared-memory transport gate, for the 64-byte, concurrency-1 cells. The latency medians (p50_us, p99_us) are the recorded numbers from bench/shm/REPORT.md's summary table (regime=default). The allocs_per_op are machine-invariant (allocation counts do not depend on CPU speed) and reflect the current transport code: production-shm 19, production-shm-sync 17, and grpc-uds 158 match REPORT.md, while production-uds is 19 here versus REPORT.md's 17 because the socket transport's per-op allocation changed across the transport commits merged after that report was written (confirmed reproducible across runs). Ratios used by the gate are computed from the stored p50 medians, not stored. To refresh, recapture a bench run: copy the latency medians and take the allocs from the current run; do not hand-edit measured values.
